reason: As a customer happy with my savings, I'd want a reason the extra $25 is worth paying. Document A gives me one: it says the app services mostly send uninsured contractors, that only 1 of 18 cleaners has left since July, and that there's no contract and a December 31 deadline, and it ends with a real name and phone number. Document B leaves out those points and still has unfilled placeholders, so it feels less concrete and less trustworthy.
